verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents end-to-end encrypted cloud backups and cross-device sync, so signing in on a new device restores your codes. A recovery key covers lockout, and encrypted exports can be imported without signing in, a second documented recovery path. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step guide for restoring on a new device after losing the phone, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a real restore (community mentions of backups are brief).

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens.
Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
